case_information.customer_feedback_summary: The feedback praises the resort’s prime beachfront location, spacious, well‑equipped apartments, multiple pools and friendly, accommodating staff, with several guests noting good breakfast and poolside food. Negative comments include maintenance and housekeeping shortcomings (running/defective toilets, intermittent water, slow warm water, jammed doors, broken toaster, stuck wardrobe door), limited signage and difficulty moving across the large site, cobblestone paths with luggage, and under‑resourced poolside/roof terrace seating and buffet quality variability.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

priorities.area: Plumbing, bathroom hygiene and water reliability
priorities.recommendation: Immediately inspect/remediate plumbing/mold, review interruptions with engineering/utility, communicate, commission urgent inspection if unclear, prioritize remediation.

priorities.area: Breakfast offering: timing, value and quality
priorities.recommendation: Assess breakfast timing/value/variety; gather feedback, consider low-cost fixes; do not commit capital/pricing changes without assessment.
Review bookings, front‑desk processes, update ambiguous access/cleaning descriptions, ensure staff explain policies, or commission review.

priorities.area: Maintenance & building systems (plumbing, locks, hot water)
priorities.recommendation: Initiate immediate engineering audit; address safety/security repairs within 72 hours; implement checklist, ticketing, guest communication/compensation.
Review housekeeping standards (tea/coffee, bottled water); audit rooms, retrain, re-examine towel policy, prepare repair inventory.

priorities.area: Guest mobility & wayfinding (site navigation, luggage assistance)
priorities.recommendation: Deploy signage/maps; implement luggage/golf-cart assistance visible at check-in; train front-desk to proactively offer mobility assistance.
